principle: A topic is covered by evidence roles, not by one feed. Aggregators discover; primary sources substantiate.

families.label: Owner documentation and knowledge base
families.evidence_role: Normative product behavior, prerequisites, limits, compatibility, and supported procedures.

families.label: Standards and specifications
families.evidence_role: Normative semantics, protocol contracts, data models, and interoperability requirements.

families.label: Release notes, roadmaps, deprecations, and compatibility matrices
families.evidence_role: What changed, when it changed, support windows, migrations, and breaking behavior.

families.label: Source repositories and tagged releases
families.evidence_role: Executable implementation, release artifacts, examples, and provenance.

families.label: Design documents, issues, pull requests, and mailing lists
families.evidence_role: Implementation rationale, unresolved limitations, regressions, and upcoming behavior.

families.label: Security advisories and vulnerability databases
families.evidence_role: Affected versions, exploitability, remediation, and vendor response.

families.label: Papers, technical reports, and theses
families.evidence_role: Novel algorithms, formal models, comparative evaluation, and prior art.

families.label: Benchmarks and reproducible evaluations
families.evidence_role: Measured performance, cost, scale, failure behavior, and methodological constraints.

families.label: Operations guides, status history, and postmortems
families.evidence_role: Production failure modes, recovery, observability, capacity, and operational burden.

families.label: Cloud, warehouse, ETL, and connector-provider documentation
families.evidence_role: Supported source/target combinations, extraction modes, limits, licensing, and operational trade-offs.

families.label: Engineering blogs and implementation case studies
families.evidence_role: Real-world architecture and lessons; claims require triangulation when commercial.

families.label: Conference talks, proceedings, slides, and recordings
families.evidence_role: Emerging practice, practitioner detail, and explanations not present in product docs.

families.label: Maintainer forums, Q&A, and practitioner communities
families.evidence_role: Discovery of edge cases and operational pain; never sufficient alone for factual claims.

families.label: API, schema, connector, package, and dataset catalogues
families.evidence_role: Inventory and discovery of concrete interfaces and artifacts.

families.label: Licensing, support policy, legal, and regulatory material
families.evidence_role: Permitted use, supportability, data handling, retention, residency, and compliance constraints.

families.label: Newsletters and aggregators
families.evidence_role: Discovery only; always follow through to the originating artifact.
